current_events: Iran claims it has destroyed an early-warning radar in Bahrain as a retaliation for a US strike on telecommunication infrastructure on Sirik
The last recorded song by the late American country singer Dolly Parton, a duet with Bono, is released as part of U2's 16th album Carnaval de Luz, months after her death in August

A tanker and the cruise ship American Heritage collide in the Mississippi River. The cruise ship, carrying 130 people, sinks. All aboard the American Heritage survive, with some taken to local hospitals for treatment of minor injuries
The Federal Aviation Administration issues a nationwide ground stop for all flights in the United States due to "extraordinary circumstances involving communications failures". It was later lifted
Twenty-four people are killed and eleven more injured in a bus–truck collision in Golaghat, India
Six people are killed and five more injured after an under construction building partially collapses in Nairobi, Kenya

In the United Kingdom, Metropolitan Police announce a criminal investigation into actor David Walliams about "alleged serious sexual offences". The police say they are separate to those investigated by ITN and The Guardian
In the United States, the State Department designates three Guatemalan criminal groups as foreign terrorist organizations for providing material support to Mexican cartels. (El País (in Spanish))

A bomb is found at an ethanol plant in Peoria, Illinois after a “credible bomb threat” was called in. An evacuation is ordered for residents within a one mile radius of the site, and some local events are cancelled
